(NormalizePlaceholderTerm / IsPlaceholder and ValidateConfirmed's sut_description rune floor).

implementations are evaluated against (Go: confirmation_precheck_gate_test.go; TS:
requirement-precheck.authority.test.ts). A semantic drift on either side fails its own gate.
Word list and threshold are never hard-coded in the client at runtime — they come from settings;
the terms/min_chars below are gate inputs, not defaults.
